rank_policy.teams: ordinal rank among 138 FBS teams within the same offense/defense metric
rank_policy.players: ordinal rank within the same CFBD metric and listed position among qualified players
rank_policy.bands: five percentile tiers calculated independently within each ranking population

definitions.wepa: CFBD opponent-adjusted model efficiency. Higher is better; plays show qualifying sample size.
definitions.paar: CFBD Points Added Above Replacement for kickers. Higher is better; attempts show qualifying sample size.

profile_sources.availability_note: Availability is a separately sourced status layer; CFBD adjusted player impact is historical performance, not an injury report.
